findings.problem: TODO claims Rayon and SmallVec will be faster with zero workload, hardware, baseline, or measurement evidence
findings.failure_mode: Developer introduces parallel overhead and layout bloat for a 4-element input, degrading latency and throughput
findings.fix: Remove the folklore claim. Measure first. For [u8; 4] inputs Rayon parallel overhead alone exceeds serial execution time.

findings.problem: Returns Vec<&'static str> for a fixed 4-element input, forcing heap allocation for trivially small output
findings.failure_mode: Every call allocates a heap Vec and four pointer entries for a result that fits in a stack array
findings.fix: Return [&'static str; 4] directly. Use [classify_byte(b) for b in *bytes] where classify_byte returns &'static str.

findings.problem: SmallVec suggestion is pointless for a known-size [u8; 4] — SmallVec's stack capacity advantage disappears when capacity is fixed at 4
findings.failure_mode: SmallVec adds compile-time generic parameter overhead and potential double-allocation fallback with no stack benefit over [T; 4]
findings.fix: Use [&'static str; 4] array return. SmallVec only helps when element count is variable and the common case is small.

findings.problem: Rayon on 4 elements is guaranteed slower — task creation, work-stealing, and result collection overhead dwarfs any parallelism benefit
findings.failure_mode: p95/p99 latency increases dramatically; throughput drops per-item due to thread-pool contention
findings.fix: Keep the serial iterator chain. For 4 elements there is no workload where Rayon scales positively.

findings.problem: No benchmark, baseline measurement, or profiler evidence exists for any performance claim or optimization direction
findings.failure_mode: Optimizations are chosen by folklore rather than measured bottleneck; regressions go undetected
findings.fix: Write a micro-benchmark for classify_four on representative inputs before changing anything. Report ops/sec and p50/p95/p99 latency.

findings.problem: No cargo check, clippy, or test compilation evidence; no benchmark commands run
findings.failure_mode: Code may have issues uncaught by absent gate commands; performance claims are unverified
findings.fix: Run cargo fmt --check, cargo check --workspace --all-targets, and cargo clippy with strict flags before any change.

missing_evidence: no benchmark exists for the stated performance claim about Rayon/SmallVec speedup
no profiler data identifying actual hot path or allocation bottleneck
no allocation tracing (e.g., heaptrack, valgrind massif) showing Vec allocation cost vs array return
no second-ring evidence (assembly diff, cache-miss counters, cycle counts) for any optimization
no baseline measurement to compare against — the current function IS the baseline
residual_risk: Static review only; no commands run. The code compiles and contains no unsafe, unwrap, or unchecked arithmetic. The primary risk is a developer acting on the folklore TODO and introducing Rayon + SmallVec, which would measurably degrade performance on [u8; 4] inputs without any measurement justification.
